subject: Request: Community credits for Code for Good Hackathon winners
messages:
From: Sam Rodriguez <sam@codeforgood.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: [Code for Good] Request: community credits for hackathon winners

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for Redwood's support last year — the session you ran was a big hit. We're running our regional Code for Good hackathon (Mar 20-22) and would love to offer winners a package of Redwood credits and trial extensions to help them continue building. Typical asks from maintainers/hack teams: $1k-$3k in credits or a 90-day extended trial, plus priority onboarding.

Quick questions:
- Do you have a standard community credit bundle for open-source maintainers or hackathon winners?
- Are hackathon recipients eligible for extended trials (we often need 60–90 days for post-event work)?
- Any programmatic constraints (per-team limits, no-commercial-use clauses)?

I've attached a short nomination form and our sponsor guidelines for context. If useful I can share a sample winners list once confirmed.

Appreciate any guidance — we try to get these commitments locked two weeks before the event.

Best,
Sam
Sam Rodriguez
Community Lead — Code for Good
sam@codeforgood.org
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: Hackathon_Nomination_Form.pdf, Sponsor_Guidelines.md

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sam Rodriguez <sam@codeforgood.org>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: [Code for Good] Request: community credits for hackathon winners

Hi Sam — great to hear from you and glad last year's session landed well. Short answer: yes, we can support winners with credits and trial extensions, but I need to confirm details with ops and legal for any per-account limits and T&Cs.

A couple of clarifying Qs:
- Approximate number of winning teams / recipients? (so we can size the grant)
- Expected start date for the credits (immediately after the event or on acceptance)?
- Are recipients primarily non-commercial open-source projects or small early-stage startups?

Looping in Tessa (Partnerships) for program logistics. I will also route to Finance/Legal if we need an agreement or sponsor acknowledgement. If you can share a provisional winners list that helps accelerate approvals.

I can usually approve up to $3k total from community budget per event; for anything beyond that I need sign-off from Monica (legal/compliance) and Vivek (platform quotas).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks — provisional winners likely 6 teams (3 winners + 3 runners-up). We expect recipients to be mix of open-source maintainers and very early-stage non-funded startups (mostly non-commercial projects). Start date: we prefer the credits activate within one week after the event so teams can iterate on their prototypes.

Attached: a draft winners list (names + contact emails) and the nomination form filled for the winners. Let me know if you need anything else.

Sam

Attachments: Winners_List.csv

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: [Code for Good] Request: community credits for hackathon winners — approval request

Team — forwarding request from Code for Good. Summary: 6 teams (3 winners + 3 runners-up), request is for ~ $500 credit per team + 90-day trial extension. I can greenlight up to $3k total from community budget, so this falls inside that.

Questions for you:
- Monica: any compliance or sponsor acknowledgement we need to include? Any legal template I should send?
- Vivek: platform/ops — can we provision short-term credits that are restricted (non-billable) and apply a 90-day trial extension? Any limits per account or per-IP we should be aware of?

If we have a quick yes from legal + ops, I'll send a sponsor confirmation and a simple redemption flow (promo codes or manual crediting).

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the summary. From Legal/Compliance:
- We can approve community credits and 90-day trial extensions for non-commercial open-source projects and early-stage teams.
- Require recipients to accept our standard trial terms (short EULA + acceptable use). No additional contract required for <$5k total.
- Recommend adding a short sponsor acknowledgement clause in the onboarding email (one-paragraph).

If any recipients are already Redwood customers or in trials, we should not double-credit. Please ask Sam to confirm.

— Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [Code for Good] Request: community credits for hackathon winners — ops check

Marissa — ops/infra note:
- We can issue 6 promo codes, each for $500 credit and a 90-day trial extension. Promo codes will be flagged as non-billable.
- One constraint: promo codes must be tied to an email address; if winners create multiple accounts, credits won't consolidate. Recommend providing redemption instructions and offering an onboarding session to apply credits to the right account.
- Rate-limits / quotas: no special per-token limits; standard free-tier throttles apply. For any team planning heavy model evaluation (many long-generation tests), advise they request a temporary quota bump — we can approve low-risk increases for community recipients.

Approve from Ops side. I will generate codes once Marissa confirms final list.

— Vivek
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Sam Rodriguez <sam@codeforgood.org>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: [Code for Good] Request: community credits for hackathon winners — approved

Hi Sam — good news: Redwood is happy to sponsor Code for Good. Approved items: 6 promo codes (each $500) + 90-day trial extension. No additional contract required for this event.

Next steps for you:
1) Confirm the final winners list and ensure none are existing Redwood customers (or let us know if they are).
2) Provide the email addresses they will use to redeem; codes must be redeemed per-email.
3) We'll send a short onboarding email that includes the sponsor acknowledgement text (see below) and redemption instructions.

Sponsor acknowledgement (can be pasted into your event materials):
"Redwood Inference is proud to sponsor Code for Good. Selected winners receive Redwood community credits and a 90-day extended trial to continue developing open-source and civic-tech projects."

Tessa will coordinate logistics and I'll ask Vivek to generate the promo codes once we have the final list. Monica — noted your guidance on standard trial terms; we'll attach the EULA link in the onboarding mail.

Looking forward to this — congrats to the teams in advance.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
